```{r setup}
source("Rscripts/utils.R")

# Global thresholds for calling a site a "peak" in a given sample
MIN_FIRE_COV <- 4
MIN_FRAC_ACC <- 0.20

# Haplotype analysis thresholds
DIFF_THRESHOLD <- 0.25
MIN_HAP_COV <- 10
```

```{r}
union_df <- my_read_bed(cmd = "bgzip -dc -@ 8 Tables/union-peaks-cons.bed.gz", sort = FALSE)
```

```{r}
union_df %>%
    filter(is_primary_sample) %>%
    filter(is_peak) %>%
    pull(consensus_peak_id) %>%
    unique() %>%
    length()
```

```{r}
peak_df <- my_read_bed(cmd = "bgzip -dc -@ 8 Tables/peaks-cons.bed.gz", sort = FALSE)
```

```{r}
peak_df %>%
    filter(is_primary_sample) %>%
    filter(is_peak) %>%
    pull(consensus_peak_id) %>%
    unique() %>%
    length()
```
